map.为常见展览安全参考值，用于快速初筛；具体限值随场馆类型与当地消防规定变化，正式评: These are common reference values for exhibition safety, used for quick screening; the exact limits vary with venue type and local fire regulations, and the formal review follows the governing codes.
map.勾选火灾报警、喷淋、排烟、应急照明、应急广播 5 类消防设施到位情况，未勾选项自: Tick off whether 5 categories of fire protection facility - fire alarm, sprinkler, smoke extraction, emergency lighting and emergency broadcast - are in place; any unticked item is automatically counted as a hazard and a rectification list is produced.
map.安全（疏散/消防/承重）评估 使用指南: Safety (evacuation / fire protection / load bearing) evaluation guide
map.展馆安全疏散/消防/承重评估工具。按 6 项检查清单评估疏散通道、消防设施与结构: Venue safety evacuation / fire protection / load-bearing evaluation tool. Assesses evacuation routes, fire protection facilities and structural load safety against a 6-item checklist, and outputs risk items with rectification advice to protect exhibition attendees.
map.录入展馆面积、容纳人数、疏散出口数与通道宽度，测算人员密度与所需疏散总宽度，提前: Enter the hall area, occupancy limit, number of exits and corridor width to compute the crowd density and the total evacuation width required, catching overcrowding or insufficient corridors early.
map.按人员数 ÷（出口总宽度×单宽通行能力 55 人/分钟）×60 近似，属粗略工程: Approximated as headcount / (total exit width x 55 people per minute per unit width) x 60; this is a rough engineering estimate, and the formal evacuation design must follow fire codes.
map.按最大疏散距离与地坪荷载阈值核查，识别超过 40m 疏散距离或承重不足的风险点，: Check against the maximum evacuation distance and floor load thresholds, flag any point where the evacuation distance exceeds 40 m or the load capacity is insufficient, and require rectification.

map.：面积 5000㎡、容纳 2000 人、4 个出口各 3m 宽、最大疏散距离 3: : an area of 5,000 m2, occupancy of 2,000 people, 4 exits each 3 m wide, a maximum evacuation distance of 35 m, a floor load of 5 kN/m2 and all 5 fire protection systems present give a crowd density of 0.4 people/m2, an estimated evacuation time of about 5.5 minutes and 0 hazards, so the conclusion is "safe and compliant".
